<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\{OrderRequestBuilder, PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder, AmountWithBreakdownBuilder, AmountBreakdownBuilder, ItemBuilder, MoneyBuilder};
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$cart = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: $_POST;
$total = 0.0; $items = [];
foreach ($cart as $sku => $qty) {
    if (!isset($PRODUCTS[$sku])) continue;
    $p = $PRODUCTS[$sku];
    $items[] = ItemBuilder::init($p['name'], MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $p['price'])->build(), (string)$qty)->build();
    $total += $p['price'] * (int)$qty;
}
if ($total <= 0) { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'empty cart']); exit; }
$r = $orders->createOrder(['body' => OrderRequestBuilder::init('CAPTURE', [
  PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder::init(AmountWithBreakdownBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))->breakdown(AmountBreakdownBuilder::init()->itemTotal(MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))->build())->build())->build())
  ->items($items)->build()
])->build(), 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
$orderId = $r->getResult()->getId();
orders_save(['token' => $orderId, 'amount' => number_format($total, 2, '.', ''), 'status' => 'CREATED', 'created' => date('c')]);
echo json_encode(['id' => $orderId]);

<?php

$orderId = $in['orderId'] ?? '';
$order = orders_get($orderId);
if (!$order) { http_response_code(404); echo json_encode(['error' => 'unknown order']); exit; }
if ($order['status'] === 'PAID') { echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]); exit; }
$capture = $orders->captureOrder(['id' => $orderId, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
$capId = $capture->getResult()->getPurchaseUnits()[0]->getPayments()->getCaptures()[0]->getId();
$order['status'] = 'PAID';
$order['transaction_id'] = $capId;
orders_save($order);
echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $capId, 'amount' => $order['amount']]);

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/orders_store.php';
function verifyWebhook($raw, $headers) {
    $id = getenv('PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID');
    if (!$id) return false;
    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Authorization: Bearer ' . get_access_token(), 'Content-Type: application/json']);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode(['auth_algo' => $headers['PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'], 'cert_url' => $headers['PAYPAL-CERT-URL'], 'transmission_id' => $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'], 'transmission_sig' => $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'], 'transmission_time' => $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'], 'webhook_id' => $id, 'webhook_event' => json_decode($raw)]));
    $res = json_decode(curl_exec($ch), true); curl_close($ch);
    return ($res['verification_status'] ?? '') === 'SUCCESS';
}
$raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
if (!verifyWebhook($raw, getallheaders())) { http_response_code(403); exit; }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../vendor/autoload.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config.php';
use PaypalServerSdkLib\PaypalServerSdkClientBuilder;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Authentication\ClientCredentialsAuthCredentialsBuilder;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Environment;
$client = PaypalServerSdkClientBuilder::init()
  ->clientCredentialsAuthCredentials(ClientCredentialsAuthCredentialsBuilder::init(getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID'), getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET')))
  ->environment(Environment::SANDBOX)->build();
$orders = $client->getOrdersController();
$payments = $client->getPaymentsController();
function get_access_token() {
    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERPWD, getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID') . ':' . getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET'));
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, 'grant_type=client_credentials');
    $res = json_decode(curl_exec($ch), true); curl_close($ch);
    return $res['access_token'];
}
